title: Reports
hub_hint: Every figure is a sum of what was stored, in both currencies
sales_hint: What was sold in the period, and what came in
purchases_hint: What was bought in the period, and what was paid
profit_hint: Sale price less the month bought price, per material
profit_basis: Margin against the month price list — it ignores actual purchase cost and damage
stock_hint: What is in the yard now, and what moved
receivables_hint: What customers owe us, highest first
payables_hint: What we owe companies, highest first
damage_hint: What was damaged, and what came back as credit
employee_activity_hint: What each employee did in the period
cash_up_hint: What each employee should hand over, per currency
no_cost_price: {{count}} lines with no bought price — excluded
capped: The largest {{shown}} of {{total}}. Narrow the period or the material to see the rest.
